scripts.deploy: npm run build && rsync -avz --delete dist/ Hertz:/var/www/html/akari-japan-place/
scripts.deploy:server: rsync -az server/server.ts server/db.ts server/set-code.ts Hertz:/var/www/japanchansky-api/ && ssh Hertz systemctl restart japanchansky-api
scripts.hertz:set-code: ssh -t Hertz "cd /var/www/japanchansky-api && sudo -u www-data DATA_DIR=/var/lib/japanchansky node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings set-code.ts"
